invention.ref: Conrad Gessner describes a wood-held graphite pencil; Borrowdale graphite in use
invention.ref_zh: 格斯纳记载木杆夹石墨的书写工具；英格兰博罗代尔石墨矿开采

mass_production.ref_zh: 德国纽伦堡出现铅笔生产

popularization.ref_zh: 孔戴在巴黎发明石墨与黏土混合笔芯

locations.place_label_zh: 英格兰博罗代尔（石墨矿）

notes: 约 1560 年意大利 Bernacotti 夫妇曾做出木杆包石墨的雏形；1565 年格斯纳的描述是较早的文字记载，因此年份精度只到十年。
summary_zh: 16 世纪 60 年代，英格兰博罗代尔的石墨被做成书写工具；1795 年孔戴的石墨黏土笔芯奠定了现代铅笔。
summary_en: Graphite from Borrowdale, England, was used for writing by the 1560s; Conté's 1795 graphite-and-clay lead defined the modern pencil.

image.alt_zh: 两支削尖的 HB 铅笔
image.credit: Original uploader was Dmgerman at en.wikipedia

notes_en: An Italian couple, the Bernacottis, made a wood-encased prototype around 1560; Gessner's 1565 description is an early written record, so the date is given to the decade.
